# Making a Vour Dev carousel from a Markdown brief

> **Self-contained build procedure.** Pair with `DESIGN.md`. Together those two files are everything an AI agent needs to produce on-brand @vourdev carousels.
>
> **Update 4 changes:** synthwave surface fully retired. `IconTile`, `CtaCircle`, `--fs-hero`, `--fs-title-tt`, and the `--pad-tt-*` tokens are gone. `--fs-title-lg` (128) / `--fs-title` (104) / `--fs-title-sm` (88) is the new headline scale. Editorial cream is the only surface. Both Instagram AND TikTok photo carousels use the same **1080 × 1350** canvas. There is no separate TikTok reframe.

---

## 0 · Two kinds of briefs

1. **On-brand brief** — uses our vocabulary (`## Eyebrow`, `## Page Counter`, `Accent Color: Amber`). Go straight to §3.
2. **Off-brand brief** — uses generic headings (`## Badge`), emoji as icons, non-brand fonts, non-brand colors. Run §2 normalization first.

---

## 1 · Canonical brief format

```markdown
# Carousel Content — <Title>

## Content Info
- Format:    Carousel Slide
- Platform:  Instagram | TikTok | both     (all use 1080×1350)
- Total Slides:  6 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10
- Audience:  <one line>
- Goal:      Saves | Shares | Comments | Awareness
- Tone:      <one line — casual Indonesian, first-person saya>
```

Then one section per slide:

```markdown
# Slide N — <Role>

## Page Counter    (skip on Cover)
02 / 08

## Eyebrow
POINT #1

## Headline
Setup line **accent phrase**

## Description
Body paragraph 1.

Body paragraph 2.

## Highlight       (optional)
One-line takeaway

## Comparison      (optional — used on Comparison slides)
### Junior
> Loser one-liner.

### Senior
> Winner rationale.

## Step 1..N       (used on Solution slides — N is 2–4)
Step 1 title.
Step 1 body.

## Visual Direction
- Icon: <iconify slug>
- Accent Color: Amber | Mint | Sky | Pink | Red | Violet
```

Caption + hashtags go at the end under `# Caption` and `# Hashtag`. They aren't rendered onto slides.

### Slide roles

| Role | Layout pattern |
|---|---|
| `Cover` | Eyebrow + hero headline + lede + brand mark + optional accent card |
| `Problem` | Eyebrow + headline + body + accent card/callout |
| `Point` (1..n) | Eyebrow + headline + body + info card |
| `Comparison` | Two stacked cards — stone (loser) + peach (winner) |
| `Solution` | Three numbered step cards |
| `Outro` | Big headline + body + highlight panel + brand footer |

### Allowed subheadings

Only these subheadings render onto slides. Anything else is ignored.

| Subheading | Renders as |
|---|---|
| `## Page Counter` | top-left `01 / NN`, JetBrains Mono 24px, `--ed-ink-faint` |
| `## Eyebrow` | ALL CAPS mono 24px in `--ed-orange` |
| `## Headline` | `--fs-title` (104) or `--fs-title-lg` (128) on cover. Wrap ONE word in `**bold**`. |
| `## Description` | `--fs-body-lg` (32). Paragraph breaks become real paragraphs. |
| `## Highlight` | Highlight panel OR small accent card, one line |
| `## Comparison` | Two stacked cards |
| `## Step 1..N` | Numbered step cards |
| `## Visual Direction` | Per-slide icon + accent config |

## 2 · Off-brand normalization

### 2.1 Front matter

| Brief says | Becomes |
|---|---|
| `Background: dark theme (#0F172A)` | (drop — editorial is the only surface) |
| `Font: Poppins / Inter / Roboto` | (drop — we use Sora + Nunito + JetBrains Mono) |
| `Canvas: 1080 × 1920` | `Canvas: 1080 × 1350` (see §3 Step 2) |
| `Accent: Cyan / Blue` | `Accent Color: Sky` |
| `Accent: Red / Warning` | `Accent Color: Red` |
| `Accent: Green / Success` | `Accent Color: Mint` |
| `Accent: Yellow / Orange` | `Accent Color: Amber` |
| `Accent: Pink / Purple` | `Accent Color: Pink` or `Violet` |

### 2.2 Badges → eyebrows

| Badge | Eyebrow |
|---|---|
| `[Mistake #N]` | `KESALAHAN #N` |
| `[React Tips]` | `REACT TIPS` |
| `[Solution]` | `SOLUSI` |
| `[Discussion]` | `DISKUSI` |
| `[Point #N]` | `POINT #N` |
| `[Hot Take]` | `HOT TAKE` |
| `[Tutorial]` | `TUTORIAL` |
| `[Career]` | `KARIR DEVELOPER` |

Eyebrows are always ALL CAPS — the `.eyebrow` CSS class does the transform. Write them title-cased in the brief.

### 2.3 Emoji → Iconify slugs

Emoji never render on slides. Map every emoji to a Lucide (or Simple Icons for brand logos) slug.

| Emoji | Slug | Accent |
|---|---|---|
| ⚠ / ⛔ | `lucide:alert-triangle` | Red |
| 💻 / 👨‍💻 | `lucide:code-2` | Sky |
| 📋 | `lucide:clipboard` | Sky |
| 🐛 | `lucide:bug` | Red |
| ❌ | `lucide:x-circle` | Red |
| 🧩 | `lucide:puzzle` | Violet |
| 📚 | `lucide:library` | Violet |
| 🚀 | `lucide:rocket` | Amber |
| ✔ / ✅ | `lucide:check-circle` | Mint |
| 🔍 | `lucide:search` | Mint |
| 💬 | `lucide:message-square` | Pink |
| 🧠 | `lucide:brain` | Sky |
| 💼 | `lucide:briefcase` | Amber |
| 📈 / 📊 | `lucide:trending-up` | Amber |
| 📉 | `lucide:trending-down` | Red |
| 👋 | (drop — use brand mark instead) | — |

For brand logos: `simple-icons:react`, `simple-icons:nextdotjs`, `simple-icons:typescript`, `simple-icons:tailwindcss`, `simple-icons:mongodb`, `simple-icons:nodedotjs`, `simple-icons:vercel`.

### 2.4 Drop off-brand sections

- `## Assets` — pick ONE icon (the most important), drop the rest.
- `## Icons` — same: pick ONE, drop the rest.
- `## Layout` — convert to `## Visual Direction`.
- `## Global Design Rules` — merge into `## Content Info`, drop the rest.

### 2.5 Slide-role mapping

| Off-brand name | Role |
|---|---|
| `Hook` / first slide | `Cover` |
| `Mistake #N` / `Problem` | `Point` (with red accent) |
| `Tip #N` / `Insight #N` | `Point` |
| `Solution` / `How to fix` | `Solution` |
| `CTA` / `Discussion` / last | `Outro` |

## 3 · Build procedure

### Step 1 — Confirm the platform

Instagram, TikTok, or both — **it doesn't matter for layout.** Both use 1080 × 1350. The only difference is where you post the final images.

### Step 2 — Confirm the canvas

**Every slide is 1080 × 1350 (4:5 portrait) with padding 80 / 96 / 80.**

> **Why not 1080×1920 for TikTok?**
>
> TikTok photo carousels display at 4:5 in the feed — the same ratio as Instagram. If you upload 9:16, TikTok crops the top and bottom to fit the 4:5 preview. Users only see the full 9:16 when they tap through to the detail view, but the feed preview is what stops the scroll.
>
> Instagram carousels are natively 4:5. So one canvas — 1080 × 1350 — displays perfectly on both platforms.

### Step 3 — Deck spine

```
Slide 1 · Cover
Slide 2 · Problem
Slide 3..N-2 · Points
Slide N-1 · Solution (or Comparison)
Slide N   · Outro
```

- 6 slides → Cover · Problem · 2 Points · Solution · Outro
- 8 slides → Cover · Problem · 4 Points · Solution · Outro
- 10 slides → Cover · Problem · 6 Points · Solution · Outro

Never invent material. If the brief has fewer points than the deck has room, drop the weakest. If more, split the strongest.

### Step 4 — Apply vertical rhythm

Every slide uses the same stack (from `DESIGN.md` §4):

```
Page counter  (skip on Cover)
   ↓ 64  (--gap-block)
Eyebrow
   ↓ 24  (--gap-badge-headline)
Headline
   ↓ 32  (--gap-headline-body)
Body / lede
   ↓ 40  (--gap-body-asset)
Cards / asset
   ↓ 48  (--gap-section, if a footer follows)
Brand row (if Cover or Outro)
```

### Step 5 — Apply the accent color

`Accent Color` from `## Visual Direction` picks the card tone:

| Accent Color | Card tone class | When |
|---|---|---|
| `Amber` | `.card-amber` | perf, speed, energy, highlight |
| `Mint` | `.card-mint` | success, growth, "yes" |
| `Sky` | `.card-sky` | tooling, info, infra |
| `Pink` | `.card-pink` | design, UI, content |
| `Red` | `.card-stone` | warning, "no", loser (stone is the muted "loser" tone) |
| `Violet` | `.card-peach` | neutral / default |

The card icon glyph is always `--ed-orange` (`#E94B19`). Only the card background changes with the accent color.

### Step 6 — Apply the headline accent word

For each `**bold**` span in `## Headline`, wrap in `<span class="a">…</span>` (which is styled `color: var(--ed-orange)`). **Maximum ONE per headline.** If the brief has more, keep the first, drop the rest.

### Step 7 — Add the brand mark

- **Cover slide** — top-left, 72px disc + `@vourdev` wordmark.
- **Outro slide** — bottom-left (`margin-top: auto`), 72px disc + wordmark.
- **Inner slides** — no logo. Page counter is enough.

Use the base64 data URL from `DESIGN.md` §3a — never fetch externally.

### Step 8 — Run the §10 checklist

All 14 items from `DESIGN.md` §10. Triple-check:
- ☐ Canvas is 1080 × 1350 (not 1920).
- ☐ Every icon sits on an opaque `--ed-card-*` background.
- ☐ One `.a` accent span per headline, no more.

### Step 9 — Caption + hashtags

Copy `# Caption` and `# Hashtag` from the brief verbatim into the post copy. They don't render onto slides — they're the accompanying text for the post itself.

## 4 · The starting template

**Do not write HTML from scratch.** Copy `TEMPLATE-editorial.html` from the bundle and replace only the placeholder content inside `<section>` tags. The `<style>` block is authoritative — don't modify it.

The template contains every slide role you need as a copy-paste block: Cover, Problem, Point, Comparison, Point-with-callout, Solution (numbered steps), Outro. Delete sections you don't need, duplicate sections you need more of.

## 5 · Slide-role recipes (quick reference)

### Cover

```
brand-row (72px disc + @vourdev)
   ↓ [flex center]
eyebrow
   ↓ 24
h1.hero — with one <span class="a">
   ↓ 32
lede (3 short paragraphs)
   ↓ 40
[optional] one accent card with icon + one-line takeaway
   [absolute bottom-left] "Geser →" hint
```

### Point (with info card)

```
counter "02 / 08"
   ↓ 64
eyebrow "POINT #1"
   ↓ 24
h1 — one accent span
   ↓ 32
body (2-3 short paragraphs)
   ↓ 40
info card:
  card-head [icon 48×48 + title Sora 700 40px]
  card-body (Nunito 500 28px, 1-2 lines)
```

### Comparison

```
counter · eyebrow · h1 (same structure as Point)
   ↓ 40
stone card:  label ALL CAPS in --ed-ink-faint + one bare line
   ↓ 16
peach card:  label ALL CAPS in --ed-orange + one line + 3-4 rationale lines
```

### Solution (3 numbered steps)

```
counter · eyebrow · h1
   ↓ 40
step 1 (amber card, 40px orange badge, title + body)
   ↓ 16
step 2
   ↓ 16
step 3
```

### Outro

```
counter · eyebrow · h1
   ↓ 32
body (2 short lines)
   ↓ 40
highlight panel:
  strong line (Sora 700 32px --ed-orange)
  ↓ 8
  sub line (Nunito 500 26px --ed-ink-soft)
   ↓ [margin-top: auto]
brand-row (72px disc + @vourdev)
```

## 6 · Hard rules

1. Canvas is **1080 × 1350**. Never 1080×1920. TikTok crops it. (Update 3)
2. Editorial is the only surface. No dark/synthwave variant.
3. Every icon in an opaque `--ed-card-*` or `--ed-icon-tile-bg` container.
4. One accent `<span class="a">` per headline.
5. Type sizes from `DESIGN.md` §3 pinned values only — 128 / 104 / 88 / 56 / 40 / 32 / 28 / 24.
6. Fonts: Sora + Nunito + JetBrains Mono. Never Inter, Poppins, Roboto, Arial.
7. Colors from the tokens. Never `#000`, `#fff`, `#0F172A`.
8. No emoji in body copy. Iconify only for icons.
9. Brand mark from `assets/vourdev-logo.jpeg` — or `DESIGN.md` §3a base64 in standalone bundles.
10. **Mockup slides pass the §8 proportion contract.** Title, eyebrow, description, and mock-screen NEVER overlap. If it doesn't fit, cut copy — never shrink font, never delete `.diag-wrap` constraints.
11. **Every file carries the §10 `vourdev-meta` block.** Never skip; use `""` / `[]` for missing fields.
12. If the user's request conflicts with these, **ask before breaking.**

## 7 · Update 3 diagram slide roles

Nine new roles for slides that need a visual mockup, not just headline + body. Every one lives on the same editorial cream + `--ed-orange` surface — no dark variant.

### Extra brief subheadings

Only allowed inside a slide already using one of the diagram roles below:

| Subheading | Renders as | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `## Diagram` | Which diagram pattern to use | One of: `concept-hub`, `flow-chain`, `token-strip`, `comparison-bars`, `icon-hub`, `illustrated-scene`, `permission-table`, `terminal`, `recap-checklist` |
| `## Nodes` | The named nodes/chips/tools/etc | Bulleted list — order matters |
| `## Highlight Node` | Which node is filled orange | One node name from the list above |
| `## Catatan` | Bottom takeaway panel body | ≤ 60 chars, single sentence |

### The nine diagram roles

| Role name | Layout | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| `Concept-hub` | Center parent node + 3–5 child pills below, curved dashed lines | "X is the parent of A, B, C…" — LLM → ChatGPT/Claude/… |
| `Flow-chain` | Row of nodes with `→` arrows; ONE filled | Sequential pipelines — RAG (Doc → Search → AI → Answer) |
| `Token-strip` | Row of chips with `↓` under each | Tokenizer viz, step-by-step breakdown |
| `Comparison-bars` | Two panels — loser (red border, dim bars) + winner (orange, full bars) | Short vs long, before vs after, bad vs good |
| `Icon-hub` | Center node + 4 line-art tool icons, dashed connectors | "X connects to A, B, C, D" — MCP → tools |
| `Illustrated-scene` | Two side-by-side mockup panels (login form + locked panel style) | Concrete "picture the app" moments — auth, permissions |
| `Permission-table` | Avatar + role → 4 CRUD cells with `✓`/`✕` | Role-based access, feature matrices |
| `Terminal` | Mac dots + syntax-highlighted code block | Skill/system prompt example, `.md` file, config snippet |
| `Recap-checklist` | 6 ticked items in mint | Final "you now know…" slide |

### Deck spine with diagrams

Recommended pattern for an 8-slide "term explainer" deck:

```
Slide 1 · Cover  (big number + title + brand)
Slide 2 · Concept-hub or Icon-hub (foundational concept)
Slide 3 · Token-strip or Flow-chain (mechanism)
Slide 4 · Comparison-bars (why-it-matters)
Slide 5 · Flow-chain or Icon-hub (advanced concept)
Slide 6 · Terminal (make it concrete)
Slide 7 · Illustrated-scene or Permission-table (real-world payoff)
Slide 8 · Recap-checklist (close + brand)
```

Never repeat the same diagram pattern twice in a row. Vary the visual rhythm.

### Build shortcuts

- **Copy the template.** `TEMPLATE-editorial-v3.html` already contains every diagram section — delete the ones you don't need instead of writing HTML from scratch.
- **Reference the samples.** `slides/09-diagram-concept-hub.html` through `slides/17-recap-checklist.html` show each pattern in isolation.
- **Working example.** `EXAMPLE-editorial.html` is a full finished deck — the reference implementation of the vocabulary.

### Update 3 hard rules (in addition to §6)

1. Diagrams on editorial cream only. No dark variant.
2. Every diagram node uses `.node` — no alternate box shapes.
3. Exactly one highlighted node per diagram (filled orange OR a topic accent).
4. Arrow strokes are 1.5px. Dashed connectors are `stroke-dasharray: 6 6`.
5. Body copy above a diagram tops out around 130 chars — the diagram deserves the room.
6. At most one CATATAN panel per slide.

## 8 · Mockup slide proportion contract  ★ Update 5

> Slides carrying a **mock-screen** — Terminal, Illustrated Scene, Permission Table, Comparison Bars, or any of the nine §7 diagram roles — must follow this exact vertical stack. If any element overlaps another, **cut copy. Never edit the CSS.**

### The locked stack

```
[96 top padding]
counter          → JetBrains Mono 24px
   ↓ 48
eyebrow          → JetBrains Mono 24px ALL CAPS orange
   ↓ 24
headline         → h1.compact 88px (NEVER 104 / 128 on a mockup slide)
   ↓ 24
description      → 30–32px, MAX 2 lines, ≤ 120 chars total
   ↓ 40
.diag-wrap { flex:1; min-height:0; display:flex; align-items:center; }
  └── terminal | scene | perm-table | diag-bars | diag-hub | diag-flow
   ↓ 24 or 40
catatan          → optional, ONE line ≤ 60 chars
[80 bottom padding]
```

### Non-negotiable rules

1. `.diag-wrap` **must** carry `flex: 1` AND `min-height: 0`. Without `min-height: 0`, a tall terminal pushes CATATAN off the 1350 canvas.
2. Mockup-slide headline uses `.compact` (88px). Full-size 104 / 128 is reserved for cover / text-only slides.
3. Mockup-slide description caps at 2 lines / ~120 chars. Cut copy — never shrink font, never remove the 40px gap.
4. Terminal body caps at **8 code lines**; each line ≤ 44 mono chars.
5. Scene `.mock` stays between `min-height: 360` and `max-height: 640`.
6. Comparison bars: each `.panel` capped at 5 rows.
7. Permission table: max 3 `.perm-row`s.
8. CATATAN is optional. If present, exactly one, one line, ≤ 60 chars.

### The pre-flight visual check

Render at 1080×1350 and confirm all four before delivering:

- ☐ Nothing overlaps.
- ☐ Every element sits fully inside the 80/96/80 padding box.
- ☐ Visible whitespace between headline → description → diagram → catatan.
- ☐ CATATAN, if present, is fully visible above the 80px bottom padding.

**If any check fails, the copy is too long.** Cut copy. Do not touch the CSS.

### Which mockup role to pick

| Topic contains… | Use role |
|---|---|
| code, config, DB queries, JSON, YAML, `.md` skill file | **Terminal** |
| auth flow, permission UI, before/after state | **Illustrated Scene** |
| role-based access, feature matrix | **Permission Table** |
| bad-vs-good, short-vs-long, before-vs-after | **Comparison Bars** |
| "X connects to A, B, C, D" | **Icon Hub** |
| term glossary, foundational concept | **Concept Hub** |
| sequential pipeline (input → step → output) | **Flow Chain** |
| tokenizer viz, step-by-step breakdown | **Token Strip** |
| final "you now know…" recap | **Recap Checklist** |

Terminal is the default for **database queries** and any code snippet.

#### Terminal role — syntax palette (pinned)

Background is `#1F0904` (never pure black). Syntax colors are locked (also in `DESIGN.md` §13.5):

| Class | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `.cmt` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.45)` | Comments |
| `.key` | `#E8B4A0` | Keys, identifiers |
| `.val` | `#B79CF2` | String values |
| `.kw`  | `#FBBF77` | Keywords, operators |
| `.num` | `#C1DE9E` | Numbers |

Never invent alternative highlight classes. Never colorise plain text.

## 9 · Content length caps  ★ Update 5

> The system's proportional balance only holds if copy stays within these budgets. Cut before you ship.

| Element | Cap |
|---|---:|
| Cover headline (`h1.hero` 128px) | ≤ 4 words / 30 chars |
| Inner headline (`h1` 104px) | ≤ 6 words / 42 chars |
| Compact headline (`h1.compact` 88px) | ≤ 3 lines / 90 chars total |
| Body / description (32px) | ≤ 3 lines / 180 chars — text-only slide |
| Body on a **mockup** slide | ≤ 2 lines / 120 chars |
| Info card title (40px) | ≤ 6 words |
| Info card body (28px) | ≤ 3 lines |
| Numbered step title | ≤ 4 words |
| Numbered step body | ≤ 2 lines |
| CATATAN body | ≤ 60 chars (one line) |
| Terminal code line | ≤ 44 mono chars |
| Terminal body | ≤ 8 lines |
| Scene mock label (`.mock-head`) | ≤ 3 words |
| Scene mock field | ≤ 20 chars |
| Perm-table role label | ≤ 2 words |

**When over budget:** cut, don't shrink. If the brief has one point too many, drop the weakest. Never invent filler; never reduce font-size to fit.

## 10 · Automation metadata block (for the export pipeline)  ★ Update 5

Every carousel HTML file must include one invisible metadata block inside `<head>`, right after the Iconify `<script>` tag:

```html
<script type="application/json" id="vourdev-meta">
{
  "title": "<the brief's title, from '# Carousel Content — <Title>'>",
  "caption": "<the full # Caption block, verbatim, newlines preserved>",
  "hashtags": ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3", "tag4"]
}
</script>
```

### Field-by-field

| Field | Source in brief | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | First line: `# Carousel Content — <Title>` — take `<Title>` only | Plain text, ≤ 80 chars. No markdown, no emoji, no trailing whitespace. |
| `caption` | Full `# Caption` block, verbatim | Preserve newlines as `\n`. Preserve emoji. JSON-escape internal `"` as `\"`. |
| `hashtags` | The `# Hashtag` block, split on whitespace or comma | Array of strings. Strip leading `#`. No duplicates. Lowercase preferred. |

### Where it goes in `<head>`

```html
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>[Carousel title] — @vourdev</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora…">
  <script src="https://code.iconify.design/iconify-icon/2.1.0/iconify-icon.min.js"></script>

  <!-- ⬇ REQUIRED: automation metadata (invisible on slides; parsed by the export pipeline) -->
  <script type="application/json" id="vourdev-meta">
  {
    "title": "…",
    "caption": "…",
    "hashtags": ["…"]
  }
  </script>
</head>
```

### Why this block exists

The GitHub Actions export pipeline reads this block **after** the HTML renders to screenshot the slides. It uses:

- `title` → file name for the exported PNGs and the Buffer draft
- `caption` → the post body Buffer queues to Instagram + TikTok
- `hashtags` → appended to the caption on both platforms

Without the block, the automation stops and the post has to be assembled by hand — defeating the whole pipeline.

### Rules

1. Exactly **one** block per file. Never duplicate the tag.
2. `id="vourdev-meta"` and `type="application/json"` are literal — do not rename either.
3. Must be **valid JSON**. Escape every internal `"` as `\"`, every newline as `\n`. Validate mentally before saving.
4. The block lives in `<head>`. Never move it into `<body>` or a `<section>`.
5. If the brief has no `# Caption`, use `""`. If no `# Hashtag`, use `[]`. **Never omit a key.**
6. Never skip the block. Even one-off / prototype carousels must include it — the pipeline sniffs every HTML file it exports.

### Worked example (database queries topic)

Brief:

```markdown
# Carousel Content — Database Query Anti-Patterns

...

# Caption
5 kesalahan query yang bikin database lambat.
Save biar nggak lupa.

Comment "1", "2", "3" — mana yang paling sering lo lakuin?

# Hashtag
#nextjs #database #sql #performance #vourdev
```

Metadata block:

```html
<script type="application/json" id="vourdev-meta">
{
  "title": "Database Query Anti-Patterns",
  "caption": "5 kesalahan query yang bikin database lambat.\nSave biar nggak lupa.\n\nComment \"1\", \"2\", \"3\" — mana yang paling sering lo lakuin?",
  "hashtags": ["nextjs", "database", "sql", "performance", "vourdev"]
}
</script>
```

Note the escapes: `\n` for line breaks, `\"` for the inner quotes around `1`, `2`, `3`. Hashtags array drops the leading `#`.

## 11 · Slide-introduction contract  ★ Update 6

> `DESIGN.md §16` is the source of truth. This section is the build-procedure companion: how to write the intro block from a Markdown brief so the caps hold.

Every slide's INTRO block — counter → eyebrow → headline → description — must pass DESIGN.md §16.4 pre-flight before you ship. The rules that matter when translating a brief:

### 11.1 Eyebrow cap (≤ 3 words / ≤ 20 chars)

| Brief writes | Emit |
|---|---|
| `POINT #1` | POINT #1 |
| `MISTAKE #2` → `KESALAHAN #2` | KESALAHAN #2 |
| `Best Practices We Follow` (5 words) | **Cut** to `BEST PRACTICES` |
| `Hot Take From A Senior Dev` (6 words) | **Cut** to `HOT TAKE` |

Eyebrows over 3 words break the layout — they wrap to two mono lines and steal 24 px of vertical room. When the brief runs long, keep the noun, drop the qualifier.

### 11.2 Headline cap by size

| Slide role | Font-size | HARD cap |
|---|---:|---|
| Cover | 128 (`h1.hero`) | ≤ 4 words / ≤ 30 chars / ≤ 2 lines |
| Text-only inner slide | 104 (`h1`) | ≤ 6 words / ≤ 42 chars / ≤ 2 lines |
| Mockup slide | 88 (`h1.compact`) | ≤ 8 words / ≤ 60 chars / ≤ 3 lines |

One `<span class="a">` per headline. If the brief `**bold**`s two words, keep the first and drop the second highlight (leave the word text; drop the `<span>`).

### 11.3 Description cap by slide type

| Slide type | HARD cap |
|---|---|
| Text-only slide (`.body`) | ≤ 2 lines / ≤ 22 words / ≤ 140 chars |
| Mockup slide (`.body`) | ≤ 2 lines / ≤ 16 words / ≤ 100 chars |

### 11.4 The conjunction check (fastest cut heuristic)

Count `dan / atau / tapi / kalau / karena / soalnya / makanya`. **Two = split.** Rewrite as two sentences and drop the weaker. Three = the description is doing three jobs; cut two.

### 11.5 When over cap — the cut order

1. Drop qualifiers (`sebenernya`, `pada dasarnya`, `biar lebih jelas`).
2. Drop the second conjunction clause.
3. Drop the entire second sentence.
4. Rewrite the whole description from scratch, one job.

**Never** shrink font, remove the 24 / 32 / 40 gaps, or delete the description entirely (a slide without a description reads as a placeholder).

---

## 12 · Single-mockup fills the full width  ★ Update 6

> `DESIGN.md §17` is the source of truth. In practice, when you're placing a mockup from a brief:

| Brief describes… | Layout | Component |
|---|---|---|
| ONE mockup | Fills `.diag-wrap` 100% width | `ImagePlate` alone / `.terminal` / any `.diag-*` diagram |
| TWO mockups (before/after, comparison) | 1fr / 1fr grid | `ImagePlatePair`, `.diag-bars`, or `SplitPanel` |
| THREE OR FOUR mockups (feature grid) | 2×2 grid | `MediaGrid columns={2}` |
| FIVE OR MORE mockups | Split into two slides | — |

A single `ImagePlate` alone in `.diag-wrap` MUST omit `ratio` — the plate fills the wrap. If you set `ratio="16 / 10"` on a solo plate, cream paper shows below it and the slide reads unfinished.

---

## 13 · Extended mockup catalog  ★ Update 6

> `DESIGN.md §18` is the source of truth. Cheat-sheet for briefs:

| Brief hints at… | Reach for |
|---|---|
| a single screenshot / product shot / app screen | Full-bleed `ImagePlate` |
| before/after screenshots (kiri/kanan, IDE/terminal, old/new UI) | `ImagePlatePair` |
| 3–4 screenshots of the same app (feature grid, moodboard) | `MediaGrid columns={2}` |
| a standout number, benchmark, percentage | `BigStat` |
| a quoted line — docs, spec author, senior dev | `PullQuote` |
| an image + a paragraph of context (equal weight) | `SplitPanel` |
| pure code / config / query / JSON / `.md` skill file | Terminal (§7.5 for syntax palette) |
| any of the nine diagram roles from §7 | §7 vocabulary |

Extra brief subheadings for these roles (used inside a slide already using one of them):

| Subheading | Renders as | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `## Stat` | Big number + unit + caption for `BigStat` | Body is `number` (e.g. `3×`), `unit` (`faster`), `caption` (one line) |
| `## Quote` | Pull-quote body for `PullQuote` | Body is the quote text, one paragraph. Trailing `— <author>, <role>` becomes the attribution |
| `## Image` | Image path + variant for `ImagePlate` / `SplitPanel` | `- src: assets/foo.png`, `- variant: window-mac \| window-web \| phone \| framed \| plain` |
| `## Images` | Multiple image paths for `MediaGrid` / `ImagePlatePair` | Bulleted list, one image per line |

---

## 14 · Delivering the file

1. Save as `<title-slug>.html` at the deck root.
2. Confirm every §6 hard rule passes.
3. Confirm every mockup slide passes the §8 pre-flight visual check.
4. Confirm the §10 `vourdev-meta` block is present, valid JSON, and inside `<head>`.
5. Optionally: also emit the raw `# Caption` and `# Hashtag` blocks as plain text alongside the HTML — the user pastes those into Buffer / IG / TikTok manually if the automation is off.
